fichas.title: Sports facility area allocation examples
fichas.summary: Five orientation examples allocate usable sports space to catchment areas of approximately 5,000 to 20,000 inhabitants. The listed facilities include track and field arenas, large and small playing fields, leisure play areas, fitness areas and tracks, roller-skating tracks, and grass play and gymnastics areas. The page states an allocation basis of 4 m² per inhabitant.
